# Testing SNP differentiation using linear models

## Read filtered SNP table and load packages

Also sets the cowplot theme

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())

FF_genomes_filtered <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")

```

## Linear models

### Plotting results from multiple tests

Note: model comparison analysis P values (comp_Pval) is NA when lm_Pval is 1. This occurs when the two groups being compared have the same mean and same variance.

```{r}
FF_2L <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/SNP_diff2L.RDS")
FF_2R <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/SNP_diff2R.RDS")
FF_3L <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/SNP_diff3L.RDS")
FF_3R <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/SNP_diff3R.RDS")
FF_X <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/SNP_diffX.RDS")

SNPdiff_data <- bind_rows(FF_2L, FF_2R, FF_3L, FF_3R, FF_X) %>% 
  mutate(CHROM = as.character(CHROM))

Xaxis_CHROM <- SNPdiff_data %>%  
  group_by(CHROM) %>% 
  summarise(center = (min(POS) + max(POS))/2)

SNPdiff_data$lm_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$lm_Pval, method = 'fdr')
SNPdiff_data$comp_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$comp_Pval, method = 'fdr')
SNPdiff_data$tue_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$tue_Pval, method = 'fdr')
SNPdiff_data$te_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$te_Pval, method = 'fdr')
SNPdiff_data$qb_b_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$qb_b_Pval, method = 'fdr')
SNPdiff_data$qb_w_adjPval <- p.adjust(SNPdiff_data$qb_w_Pval, method = 'fdr')
```

### Plot for publication: LM adjusted p-value

```{r}
# lm adjusted
pltmanu_lm_adj <- ggplot(data = SNPdiff_data, aes(
x = POS, y = -log10(lm_adjPval), size = -log10(lm_adjPval))) +
  facet_grid(.~ CHROM, scales = 'free_x', space = 'free_x',
             switch = 'x') +
  geom_point(aes(color = CHROM, alpha = -log10(lm_adjPval))) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
  values = rep(c("steelblue3", "skyblue"), 
               length(Xaxis_CHROM$CHROM))) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.05, 0.8)) +
  labs(y = "-log10(Adjusted P-Value)",
       x = "Chromosome Arm",
       title = "Linear model: adjusted P-values") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = 'dotted', color = 'red') +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = 'none',
          panel.spacing.x = unit(0, 'lines'), 
          strip.background.x = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = 'outside') 

print(pltmanu_lm_adj)
```

#### Linear model: Plot P-values, read depth and allele frequency for target SNPs

```{r}
target_SNPs <- SNPdiff_data %>% filter(lm_adjPval < 0.05) 

target_SNPs_pvals <- target_SNPs %>% 
  mutate("SNP_ID" = paste(CHROM, POS, sep = '_')) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("Pval"),
               names_to = "Res", values_to = "Pval") %>% 
  mutate("logPval" = -log10(Pval))



target_SNP_full <- semi_join(FF_genomes_filtered, target_SNPs)

target_SNP_full <- full_join(target_SNP_full, target_SNPs)

target_SNP_full <- target_SNP_full %>%
  dplyr::select(-REF, -ALT) %>% 
  mutate("SNP_ID" = paste(CHROM, POS, sep = '_')) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
  cols = c(starts_with('freq_'), starts_with('N_')),
  names_to = c(".value", "Population"),
  names_pattern = "(freq|N)_(.*)"
  ) %>% rename(depth = N) %>% 
  # Removes all text after the second underscore,
  # used to remove _G13_sample...
  # this leaves freq_CON1, N_CON1, and so on.
  mutate(Population = str_remove(Population, "_.*")) %>% 
  separate_wider_regex(
    cols = Population,
    patterns = c("Selection" = ".*", "PopReplicate" = "\\d$")
    ) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Selection", "PopReplicate"), factor)

SNPfreq_segments <- target_SNP_full %>% 
  group_by(SNP_ID, Selection, CHROM, POS) %>% 
  summarise(mSelfreq = mean(freq), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Selection, values_from = mSelfreq) %>% 
  mutate(selmin = pmin(CON, FP), selmax = pmax(CON, FP))

SNPdepth_segments <- target_SNP_full %>% 
  group_by(SNP_ID, Selection, CHROM, POS) %>% 
  summarise(mSeldepth = mean(depth), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Selection, values_from = mSeldepth) %>% 
  mutate(selmin = pmin(CON, FP), selmax = pmax(CON, FP))


# P values of different analyses
tSNP_resplot <- target_SNPs_pvals %>% filter(str_detect(Res, "adj")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = logPval, x = SNP_ID, color = Res)) +
                facet_wrap(~ Res, nrow = 2, ncol = 3) +
                geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color = 'red', linetype = 'dotted')+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

print(tSNP_resplot)

chrom_labs <- c("2R" = "", "3L" = "3L", "3R" = "3R", "X" = "X")

# Read depth plot
depth_tSNP_plt <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = target_SNP_full, aes(
    x = SNP_ID, y = depth, color = Selection, shape = PopReplicate), 
    alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(data = SNPdepth_segments, aes(
    x = SNP_ID, xend = SNP_ID, y = selmin, yend = selmax), 
    color = 'gray30', linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(.~CHROM, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
          labeller = labeller(CHROM = as_labeller(chrom_labs))) +
  stat_summary(data = target_SNP_full, aes(
    x = SNP_ID, y = depth, color = Selection), 
    fun = mean, size = 1.8, shape = '-') +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
 values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
 scale_shape_manual(name = "Replicate",
 values = c("1" = 15, "2" = 16, "3" = 17, "4" = 18)) +
geom_hline(yintercept = 20, color = 'red', linetype = 'dotted') +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 160, by = 20)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = 
    element_text(angle = 315, size = 6, hjust = 0.1, vjust = 0.5),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
  panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines")) +
  labs(y = "Read depth", x = "SNP_ID", shape = "Replicate")

print(depth_tSNP_plt)

# Frequency plot
freq_tSNP_plt <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = target_SNP_full, aes(
  x = SNP_ID, y = freq, color = Selection, shape = PopReplicate), 
    alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(data = SNPfreq_segments, aes(
    x = SNP_ID, xend = SNP_ID, y = selmin, yend = selmax), 
    color = 'gray30', linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(.~CHROM, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
          labeller = labeller(CHROM = as_labeller(chrom_labs))) +
  stat_summary(data = target_SNP_full, aes(
    x = SNP_ID, y = freq, color = Selection), 
    fun = mean, size = 1.8, shape = '-') +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
 values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) +
 scale_shape_manual(name = "Replicate",
 values = c("1" = 15, "2" = 16, "3" = 17, "4" = 18)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = 
    element_text(angle = 315, size = 6, hjust = 0.1, vjust = 0.5),
  panel.grid.major.y = 
    element_line(
      color = 'lightgray', linewidth = 0.5, linetype = 'dotted'),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
  panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "lines")) +
  labs(y = "Reference allele frequency", x = "SNP_ID", 
       shape = "Replicate")

print(freq_tSNP_plt)

# allele frequency vs. read depth plot
freq_depth_scatter <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = target_SNP_full, aes(

 scale_shape_manual(name = "Replicate",
```

#### OLD: For each locus, fit the following models:

i\) A linear model with default settings (normal distribution)

ii\) A generalized linear model with quasibinomial distribution

```{r}

FF_matrix_raw <- FF_genomes_filtered[1:1000, seq(5,12, by=1)]
FF_depth <- FF_genomes_filtered[1:1000, seq(13,20, by=1)]

FF_matrix <- as.matrix(FF_matrix_raw)
FF_depth <- as.matrix(FF_depth)

linear_output <- numeric(length = nrow(FF_matrix))

ttest_output <- numeric(length = nrow(FF_matrix))

quasibinom_output <- numeric(length = nrow(FF_matrix))

perc_tracker <- round(nrow(FF_matrix) * 0.05)

paste0("Progress: START")

for(ii in 1:nrow(FF_matrix)){
  FF_temp <- data.frame(
    "Treatment" = rep(c("CON","FP"), each = 4), 
    "Frequency" = FF_matrix[ii,],
    "Depth" = FF_depth[ii,])
  
  # quasibinomial model
  quasibinom_FFtemp <- glm(data = FF_temp,
  Frequency ~ Treatment,
  family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"),
  weights = Depth)

  quasibinom_output[ii] <- as.double(tidy(quasibinom_FFtemp)[2,5])

  # Arcsine squareroot transform data before fitting linear models
  FF_temp <- FF_temp %>%
    mutate(Freq_asqrt = asin(sqrt(Frequency)))
  # 
  # linear model with anova
  mod_FF_temp <- lm(data = FF_temp, 
                    Freq_asqrt ~ Treatment)
  mod_FF_temp <- anova(mod_FF_temp)
  linear_output[ii] <- mod_FF_temp$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  
  # t test
  ttest_FFtemp <- t.test(data = FF_temp, 
                         Freq_asqrt ~ Treatment, var.equal = TRUE)
  ttest_output[ii] <- ttest_FFtemp$p.value
  
  
  
  if (ii %% perc_tracker == 0){
    current_per <- (ii/nrow(FF_matrix) * 100)
    cat("Progress: ", current_per, "%\n")
  }
}

FF_results <- FF_genomes_filtered[1:1000, c(1, 2)] %>% 
             mutate(CHROM = fct_drop(CHROM))

FF_results$lm_Pval <- linear_output
FF_results$lm_adjPval <- p.adjust(linear_output, method = "fdr")
FF_results$lm_postadj <- p.adjust(FF_results$lm_Pval, method = "fdr")

FF_results$t_Pval <- p.adjust(ttest_output, method = "fdr")
FF_results$t_adjPval <- p.adjust(ttest_output, method = "fdr")
FF_results$t_postadj <- p.adjust(ttest_output, method = "fdr")

FF_results$qb_Pval <- p.adjust(quasibinom_output, method = "fdr")
FF_results$qb_adjPval <- p.adjust(quasibinom_output, method = "fdr")
FF_results$qb_postadj <- p.adjust(quasibinom_output, method = "fdr")

```

### OLD: Manual t test calculation

Manually calculate t-test via matrix calculations.

```{r}
SNP_ID <- paste0(FF_genomes_filtered$CHROM, "_", FF_genomes_filtered$POS)

mat_CON <- as.matrix(FF_genomes_filtered[, c("freq_CON1", "freq_CON2", "freq_CON3", "freq_CON4")])
rownames(mat_CON) <- SNP_ID

mat_FP <- as.matrix(FF_genomes_filtered[, c("freq_FP1", "freq_FP2", "freq_FP3", "freq_FP4")])
rownames(mat_FP) <- SNP_ID

# Arcsine squareroot transformation
mat_CON <- asin(sqrt(mat_CON))
mat_FP <- asin(sqrt(mat_FP))

mean_CON <- rowMeans(mat_CON)
mean_FP <- rowMeans(mat_FP)

n_CON <- ncol(mat_CON)
n_FP <- ncol(mat_FP)

var_CON <- (rowSums(mat_CON^2) - (n_CON * (mean_CON^2)))/(n_CON - 1)
var_FP <- (rowSums(mat_FP^2) - (n_FP * (mean_FP^2)))/(n_FP - 1)

sesq_CON <- var_CON/n_CON
sesq_FP <- var_FP/n_FP
se_total <- sqrt(sesq_CON + sesq_FP)

t_stat <- (mean_CON - mean_FP)/se_total

# Welch-Satterthwaite d.o.f. calculation
dof_numer <- (sesq_CON + sesq_FP)^2
dof_denom <- ((sesq_CON^2)/(n_CON-1)) + ((sesq_FP^2)/(n_FP-1))
dof_welch <- dof_numer/dof_denom

p_vals <- pt(abs(t_stat), dof_welch ,lower.tail=FALSE) * 2

test_loop <- 1000
random_indices <- sample(1:nrow(mat_CON), test_loop, replace = FALSE)
t_match <- tibble(indices = random_indices, 
                  manual_ttest = numeric(length = test_loop),
                  R_ttest = numeric(length = test_loop),
                  difference = numeric(length = test_loop))
cc <-  0
for(rr in random_indices){
  cc <-  cc + 1
  t_match$manual_ttest[cc] <- p_vals[rr]
  
  t_try <- t.test(mat_CON[rr, ], mat_FP[rr, ])
  t_match$R_ttest[cc] <- t_try$p.value
  
  t_match$difference[cc] = t_match$manual_ttest[cc] - t_match$R_ttest[cc] 
  
  #stopifnot(p_vals[rr] == t_try$p.value)  
}

# plot -log10 of the difference between 1000 random t tests and manual t test.
boxplot(-log10(abs(t_match$difference) + 0.1^20))

na_indices <- which(!complete.cases(t_match$difference))

boxplot(-log10(p_vals))

adj_pvals <- p.adjust(p_vals, method = 'fdr')

boxplot(-log10(adj_pvals))
```

#### Scanplot for manual t-test p-values

```{r}
FF_ttestres <- p_vals %>% as_tibble(rownames = "SNP_ID") %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = SNP_ID,
    delim = "_",
    names = c("Chromosome", "Position")
  ) %>% rename(P_vals = value) %>% mutate(Position = as.numeric(Position))


# FDR correction on P values
FF_ttestres$adj_pvals <- p.adjust(p_vals, method = "fdr")

# Chromosomal IDs for scanplot
Xaxis_CHROM <- FF_ttestres %>% group_by(Chromosome) %>% 
  summarise(center = (min(Position) + max(Position))/2)

ttest_scanplot <- ggplot(data = FF_ttestres, aes(
x = Position, y = -log10(adj_pvals), size = -log10(adj_pvals))) +
  facet_grid(.~ Chromosome) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Chromosome), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
  values = rep(c("steelblue3", "skyblue"), 
               length(Xaxis_CHROM$Chromosome))) +
  ylim(c(0, 3)) +
  ylab("-log10(FDR adjusted P Value)") +
  xlab("Position") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = 'dotted', color = 'red') +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = 'none')

print(ttest_scanplot)
```
